'''Orbital Foundry 7''' was<ref name="Catalyst" /> an [[ICM-092792]] construction module<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /> stationed in [[orbit]] over the [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]]-held [[planet]] [[Geonosis]] that assisted in the [[Project Stardust|construction]] of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[battle station]]. It was the second largest structure then viewable from the command habit. Tens of thousands of [[Warrior caste (Geonosian)|Geonosian drones]] had been transferred there to oversee production.<ref name="Catalyst" />
